scope: Exact periodic-lattice Ward-identity and completion-freedom fixture only; not a simulation of linearized gravity, not a model of a laboratory controller, and not a verdict on the Chen--Giacomini phase.
theorem_statement: For the linearized symmetric-tensor coupling, a probe-only source with nonzero divergence has a gauge-dependent coupling. A controller carrying the opposite divergence restores total conservation and gauge invariance. Conservation alone selects only an affine completion class: divergence-free controller additions preserve gauge invariance while changing a held-out interaction pairing.
